environment.description: Go Gin application deployed on a bare EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2), directly exposed on port 8080 via public IP. No reverse proxy, no load balancer, no WAF. The profile.html template uses {{ .Bio | safe }} to render user bios as raw HTML. Application serves responses without any Content-Security-Policy headers. Users can directly reach all endpoints including /admin/promote/.

config.deployment: bare EC2 t3.medium, public subnet, security group allows 0.0.0.0/0:8080
